item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 05/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The weather will be mainly fine over region. A dry northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China gradually on Saturday. It will be cool in the morning over the region in the following couple of days. With the monsoon moderating midweek next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to bring cooler weather to the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week.
